overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（10 篇）、资产定价（1 篇）、公司金融（1 篇）。方法上以均衡模型、优化方法为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、Semantic Scholar（5 篇）。

papers.title: Non-Equilibrium Economics: A Physicist's Point of View
papers.abstract: Financial and economic history is strewn with bubbles and crashes, booms and busts, crises and upheavals of all sorts. Understanding the origin of these events is arguably one of the most important problems in economic theory: are economies intrinsically unstable, and can one ``stabilize unstable economies''? In this review I argue, from a physicist's vantage point, that the concept of equilibrium -- so central to mainstream economic thinking -- is likely to be the exception rather than the rule in large, complex, interacting systems. Drawing on a series of stylized ``toy'' models, I show how excess volatility, endogenous crises and crashes, inflation swells and persistent inequalities can all emerge naturally from genuinely out-of-equilibrium dynamics, without invoking large exogenous shocks. Three generic mechanisms recur throughout: trapping in a multiplicity of history-dependent equilibria; the impossibility of dynamically reaching equilibrium, leading to oscillations and chaos; and the spontaneous evolution towards fragile, marginally stable states -- the self-organized criticality paradigm. I stress that these are phenomenological scenarios rather than calibrated theories: there is, at this stage, no ``smoking gun''. But the burden of proof, I contend, should be on the equilibrium camp.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】金融与经济史充满了各种泡沫与崩盘、繁荣与萧条、危机与动荡。理解这些现象的起源无疑是经济理论中最重要的问题之一：经济体系是否本质上就不稳定？我们是否能够“稳定那些不稳定的经济”？在这篇综述中，我从物理学家的角度出发，认为主流经济思想中核心的“均衡”概念，在大型、复杂且相互作用的系统中可能属于例外情况，而非普遍规律。通过一系列简化的“模型实验”，我展示了过度波动、内生性危机与崩盘、通货膨胀以及持续的不平等现象，是如何在真正非均衡的动态过程中自然产生的，而无需借助外生的冲击因素。其中三个普遍存在的机制包括：陷入多种历史依赖的均衡状态；动态过程中无法达到均衡状态，从而导致振荡与混沌；以及系统自发演化为脆弱且勉强稳定的状态——这符合自组织临界性理论（self-organized criticality paradigm）。我强调，这些只是现象学层面的描述，并非经过严格验证的理论框架；目前尚无确凿的证据支持这些观点。然而，我认为，证明这些理论正确性的责任应该落在支持均衡论者身上。。研究方法：模型校准、均衡模型。

papers.title: Regional Economic Impacts of the Just Energy Transition: Lessons for Coal Regions
papers.abstract: The coal phase-out's regional economic impact is a key challenge of the energy transition, as employment and fiscal dependence in coal regions face structural adjustment without automatic market solutions. Analyzing European Union NUTS 2 regions from 2000-2022 with fixed effects and clustered errors, coal regions show a consistent 1.1 percentage points unemployment premium and grow faster in gross domestic product per capita at 0.2 percentage points annually, indicating a hollowing-out process where population exit raises per-capita output while employment conditions worsen. Spatial analysis shows strong geographic clustering, supporting coordinated local and sectoral targeted transition policies. South Korea's rapid phase-out, with Chungnam as a major coal-power region, underscores the need for proactive national support to enable concrete regional action before plants shut down.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】煤炭产业的逐步淘汰对区域经济产生了重大影响，这成为能源转型过程中的关键挑战。由于煤炭产业地区的就业状况和财政依赖性存在结构性问题，而这些问题无法通过市场机制自动得到解决，因此这些地区需要经历调整。通过对欧盟NUTS 2级别区域在2000年至2022年间的数据进行固定效应分析和聚类误差分析，研究发现：煤炭产业地区失业率普遍高出1.1个百分点；同时，这些地区的人均国内生产总值年增长率比其他地区高出0.2个百分点。这一现象表明，随着人口流失，人均产出有所提升，但就业状况却在恶化。空间分析结果显示，煤炭产业地区的分布具有明显的地理聚集特征，这为制定协调一致的本地化及行业针对性转型政策提供了依据。韩国的煤炭产业淘汰进程尤为迅速，其中忠清南道作为重要的煤炭发电基地，这一案例凸显了在相关电厂关闭之前，国家层面需要提供积极的支持，以推动各地区采取切实有效的应对措施。。研究方法：固定效应。

papers.title: How Cross-Border E-Commerce Empowers the Internationalization of Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises: Mechanisms, Constraints and Optimization Paths
papers.abstract: Digital technologies and platform economies are changing how small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) enter international markets. Based on transaction cost theory, the resource-based view and absorptive capacity theory, this paper explains how cross-border e-commerce empowers SME internationalization. The study argues that platform traffic, transaction data, logistics services, digital finance, compliance tools and public services reduce market-entry costs and partly compensate for SME resource constraints. Yet these external resources do not automatically become international capabilities. Their effects depend on digital absorptive capacity, namely the ability to acquire, assimilate, transform and exploit platform-based information. Cross-border e-commerce works through three mechanisms: transaction cost reduction and market expansion, ecological resource compensation, and capability upgrading driven by data feedback and compliance pressure. The paper identifies platform dependence, weak control over customer data, logistics pressure, supply-chain fragility and rising overseas compliance costs as major constraints, and proposes optimization paths centered on lightweight data systems, differentiated platform deployment, shared service infrastructure and whole-process compliance management.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】数字技术和平台经济正在改变中小企业（SMEs）进入国际市场的模式。本文基于交易成本理论、资源基础观以及吸收能力理论，阐述了跨境电子商务如何助力中小企业实现国际化。研究发现，平台流量、交易数据、物流服务、数字金融、合规工具以及公共服务能够降低市场进入成本，并在一定程度上弥补中小企业的资源短板。然而，这些外部资源并不会自动转化为企业的国际竞争力；其实际效果取决于企业的数字吸收能力，即企业获取、整合、转化和利用平台信息的能力。跨境电子商务通过三种机制发挥作用：降低交易成本、拓展市场范围、以及通过数据反馈和合规压力推动企业能力提升。文章指出了平台依赖性、对客户数据控制力薄弱、物流压力大、供应链脆弱性以及海外合规成本上升等主要制约因素，并提出了优化路径，包括构建轻量级数据系统、差异化平台布局、共享服务基础设施以及实施全过程合规管理。。研究方法：优化方法。

papers.title: An Empirical Analysis of Factors Affecting Gross Domestic Savings in India (1991 to 2023)
papers.venue: Journal of Economics Management and Trade
papers.abstract: This study examines the factors associated with gross domestic savings in India during 1991–2023. Gross domestic savings provide an important source of domestic resources for investment, capital formation and economic growth, especially in a developing economy where reliance on external finance may increase vulnerability. The study uses secondary annual data from the RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian Economy and the World Bank. Gross domestic savings is treated as the dependent variable, while gross domestic product, broad money, inflation, tax revenue and bank credit to the private sector are used as explanatory variables. The analysis applies unit root testing through the Augmented Dickey-Fuller and Phillips-Perron procedures, followed by the ARDL bounds testing approach to examine long-run and short-run relationships. The results indicate the existence of a long-run relationship among the selected variables. Gross domestic product and bank credit to the private sector show positive and significant associations with gross domestic savings. In contrast, broad money and tax revenue show negative effects, while inflation is not statistically significant in the Indian case. The error correction term is negative and significant, indicating adjustment towards long-run equilibrium. The findings suggest that strengthening income growth, improving productive credit availability and encouraging household financial savings may support the mobilisation of domestic savings in India.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】本研究探讨了1991年至2023年间印度国内储蓄率的相关影响因素。国内储蓄是投资、资本形成和经济增长的重要国内资源来源，尤其是在发展中国家，由于对外部融资的依赖可能增加经济脆弱性。研究使用了印度储备银行（RBI）《印度经济统计手册》和世界银行的年度二手数据。国内储蓄被作为因变量，而国内生产总值（GDP）、广义货币供应量、通货膨胀率、税收收入以及向私营部门的银行贷款则被用作解释变量。分析首先通过扩展的迪基-富勒（Augmented Dickey-Fuller）和菲利普斯-佩伦（Phillips-Perron）方法进行单位根检验，随后采用ARDL边界检验方法来分析变量之间的长期和短期关系。研究结果表明，所选变量之间存在长期相关性：国内生产总值和向私营部门的银行贷款与国内储蓄呈正相关且显著；相比之下，广义货币供应量和税收收入对国内储蓄具有负面影响，而通货膨胀在印度样本中并未表现出统计学上的显著性。误差修正项为负且显著，表明数据正在向长期均衡状态调整。研究结论认为，加强经济增长、改善生产性信贷的可获得性以及鼓励家庭储蓄有助于提升印度的国内储蓄水平。。研究方法：误差修正模型、均衡模型。

papers.title: Perturbed utility Markovian traffic equilibrium: theory and computation
papers.abstract: Large-scale traffic assignment requires equilibrium models that are both behaviorally plausible and computationally tractable. This paper develops a perturbed utility Markovian equilibrium (PUME) framework that preserves the scalability of link-based Markovian traffic equilibrium models and extends their applicability to settings with boundary choice probabilities, undiscounted network loading, and general link interactions. As the behavioral basis of PUME, we first develop the perturbed utility Markovian choice model (PUMCM) in which the Bellman optimality operator is defined through a convex surplus function whose gradient directly yields the optimal policy. The model generalizes existing additive random utility (ARUM) Markovian choice models and admits both interior and boundary choice probabilities. Accordingly, unattractive links can receive zero flow without imposing ex ante choice-set restrictions as in existing ARUM models. We establish conditions under which the corresponding Markov decision problem is well posed and yields a proper demand mapping. We then formulate the equilibrium as a variational inequality (VI) problem on the dual cost space and establish its existence and uniqueness. Particularly, the VI formulation of PUME accommodates non-separable and asymmetric cost structures and thus offers a more flexible modeling framework than existing Markovian traffic equilibrium (MTE) models. For computation, we develop a modified policy iteration method for network loading and a safeguarded accelerated meta-algorithm for computing equilibrium. Both algorithms are proven to be globally convergent and have demonstrated satisfactory numerical performances. Experiments on benchmark and synthetic networks further show that the proposed framework is highly scalable and robust towards a wide variety of demand-supply settings.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】大规模交通分配需要既符合行为逻辑又在计算上可行的均衡模型。本文提出了一种基于扰动效用马尔可夫均衡（PUME）的框架，该框架保留了基于链接的马尔可夫交通均衡模型的可扩展性，并将其适用范围扩展到了包含边界选择概率、未折现的网络负载以及一般链接交互作用的场景。作为PUME的行为基础，我们首先构建了扰动效用马尔可夫选择模型（PUMCM），在该模型中，贝尔曼最优性算子通过一个凸剩余函数来定义，该函数的梯度直接决定了最优策略。该模型扩展了现有的加性随机效用（ARUM）马尔可夫选择模型，同时允许内部选择概率和边界选择概率的存在。因此，不吸引人的链接可以接收零流量，而无需像现有ARUM模型那样事先对选择集进行限制。我们确立了相应的马尔可夫决策问题能够良好构建并产生合理需求映射的条件。随后，我们将均衡问题表述为对偶成本空间上的变分不等式（VI）问题，并证明了其存在性和唯一性。特别是，PUME的VI表述方式能够适应不可分离和不对称的成本结构，从而提供了比现有马尔可夫交通均衡（MTE）模型更灵活的建模框架。在计算方面，我们开发了一种改进的策略迭代方法用于处理网络负载问题，以及一种加速的元算法用于求解均...。研究方法：均衡模型、实验方法。

papers.title: Large-Scale Portfolio Optimization Problem Under Cardinality Constraint With Enhanced Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithms
papers.abstract: Decision-making is posing an increasingly formidable challenge to investors because of the growing number of alternatives available in financial markets. A hot area of research over the past few decades has been portfolio optimization that seeks to determine how much an investor should invest in which asset. Introducing real-world conditions to the optimization model turns the problem into an NP-hard one for whose solution exact methods become inefficient; hence, researchers have turned to evolutionary algorithms to approximate solutions. In this paper, strengthening strategies are presented for multi-objective evolutionary algorithms that can provide a faster convergence rate and extensive search ability in the portfolio optimization problem under the cardinality constraint. To implement those features, a unique solution representation, a novel operator, and new repair mechanisms are introduced for solving the aforementioned problem in which lower and upper limits are set on the number of assets in the portfolio. For this purpose, new mating strategies along with the aforesaid package are implemented in well-known multi-objective evolutionary algorithms to solve the problem. The customized algorithms are subsequently tested against traditional ones using well-known market indices as benchmarks. Results indicate that the proposed strategy not only provides better approximations but also converges faster as well at no loss of performance with an increasing number of assets in the market.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】由于金融市场中的可选投资方案日益增多，决策过程对投资者来说正变得越来越具有挑战性。过去几十年来，投资组合优化一直是研究的热点领域，其核心目标是确定投资者应在哪些资产上投入多少资金。将现实世界中的各种条件纳入优化模型后，该问题被归类为NP难问题（即无法通过确定性算法高效求解的问题）；因此，研究人员转向使用进化算法来近似求解。本文提出了一种针对多目标进化算法的优化策略，该策略能够在满足基数约束的前提下提高收敛速度并增强搜索能力。为实现这些目标，研究人员引入了一种独特的解决方案表示方法、一种新型运算符以及新的修复机制，用于处理投资组合中资产数量受到上下限限制的情况。为此，这些改进措施被整合到现有的多目标进化算法中，并通过知名市场指数作为基准对改进后的算法与传统算法进行了对比测试。测试结果表明，所提出的策略不仅能够提供更精确的近似解，而且在市场资产数量增加时仍能保持较快的收敛速度，且性能并未下降。。研究方法：优化方法。

papers.title: A novel robust mixed integer linear programming model for index tracking problem under no rebalancing: heuristic optimization approach
papers.abstract: Passive management has increasingly won popularity over the past few years because of its advantages, such as lower management fees and transaction costs. Index tracking endeavors to reproduce the performance of an index with smaller sets of assets. In this paper, a novel formulation is proposed that is not only more robust than the existing ones but also performs better on out-of-sample data and tracks indices over long periods without any considerable deviation or the need for rebalancing. Solving index tracking problems in a polynomial time is a challenging task due to their NP-hard nature. To address this issue, a novel heuristic based on metaheuristic algorithms and local branching is also developed to solve the proposed model. The heuristic enjoys not only the exploration capabilities of a genetic algorithm but the characteristics of local search algorithms as well. The data from the OR library is used to verify the capabilities of the proposed heuristic in comparison with commercial solvers. Results indicate that not only is the heuristic able to converge to optimal solutions for not-so-large problem sizes, but the portfolios it generates also outperform those yielded by commercial solvers in terms of both in-sample and out-of-sample data.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：指数跟踪问题具有NP-hard性质，求解具有挑战性，且现有模型在长期跟踪和稳健性方面存在不足。

🔬 研究方法：提出了一种新的稳健混合整数线性规划模型，并开发了一种结合遗传算法探索能力和局部搜索特征的启发式优化方法。

📊 核心发现：新方法不仅能收敛到小规模问题的最优解，且生成的投资组合在样本内和样本外数据上的表现均优于商业求解器。

💡 应用价值：该研究为被动管理提供了一种高效且稳健的解决方案，能够在无需再平衡的情况下长期跟踪指数表现。

papers.title: Misspecified regressions with mixed regressors: robust inference and causal interpretation
papers.abstract: For analytic convenience, existing statistical frameworks either assume random or fixed regressors. However, it is a little awkward that they do not cover the practical case of estimating the average treatment effect in experiments with randomized treatments and non-randomized, fixed pretreatment covariates. We unify the literature by providing the theory for regressions with mixed regressors that contain both random and fixed components. Importantly, our theory allows for misspecification of the regression functions. We first establish general results for estimating equations with both random and fixed components and then use it to analyze misspecified linear regression, with applications to completely randomized experiments. We focus on the causal interpretation of the regression coefficients and standard errors even when the models are wrong. We start with the theory for independent data and then extend the discussion to clustered data.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】为了分析上的便利，现有的统计框架要么假设回归量是随机的，要么假设回归量是固定的。然而，这些框架未能涵盖这样一个实际问题：即在实验中，当处理方式是随机化的，而预处理协变量是固定的时，如何估计平均处理效应。我们通过提出一种适用于包含随机和固定成分的混合回归量的理论，从而统一了相关研究。重要的是，我们的理论允许回归函数存在设定错误的情况。我们首先建立了适用于同时包含随机和固定成分的估计方程的一般性结果，然后利用这些结果来分析设定错误的线性回归模型，并将其应用于完全随机化的实验。即便模型存在错误，我们也关注回归系数和标准误差的因果解释。我们的讨论从独立数据的情况开始，随后扩展到了分组数据的情况。。研究方法：回归分析、随机实验、实验方法。

papers.title: Does Regulation Bite at Gateways? Evidence from MiCA and Stablecoins
papers.abstract: Gateways are trading venues where regulation can change the assets investors can trade. We study this margin using MiCA-EU's Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation-which led several exchanges to delist USDT pairs for European Economic Area users, while USDC obtained MiCA authorization. First, aggregate market shares and trading volumes barely move. Second, comparing Regulated-facing exchanges with globally oriented exchanges where MiCA is less likely to bind, we show that the cross-section shifts toward USDC-USDC share rises by 0.82 and relative trading volume by 0.54 pre-event standard deviations. Both reflect USDT trading contracting where it is delisted.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】门户平台（Gateways）是那些受到监管影响的交易场所，这些监管措施会改变投资者可以交易的资产种类。我们利用MiCA-EU（欧盟加密货币资产监管法规）来研究这一现象——该法规导致多家交易所暂停为欧洲经济区用户提供USDT交易对服务，而USDC则获得了MiCA的监管授权。研究发现：首先，整体市场份额和交易量几乎没有变化；其次，将受MiCA监管影响的交易所与那些以全球市场为导向、MiCA法规约束力较弱的交易所进行对比后，我们发现事件发生前USDC交易对的交易份额上升了0.82个标准差，相对交易量上升了0.54个标准差。这两种变化均表明，在USDT被暂停交易的交易所中，USDT的交易活动明显减少。。研究方法：横截面分析。

papers.title: Perpetual Futures in Decentralised Finance: Mechanics, Economic Claims, and the Drivers of Trading Volume
papers.abstract: DeFi perpetual futures have expanded from crypto-native instruments to tokenised equities and commodities, yet the economics of these instruments remain poorly understood. We study 17 assets—5 crypto coins, 8 tokenised equities, and 4 tokenised commodities—on three DeFi perpetual platforms (Hyperliquid, EdgeX, Lighter) over July 2025 to February 2026. Applying a rolling 3-day t-test to identify abnormal trading volume without a predetermined event calendar, we document 1797 statistically significant volume anomalies. DeFi perpetual volume is driven primarily by macroeconomic and policy shocks (ADA t=+628 on the U.S. Crypto Strategic Reserve announcement; 15 of 17 assets simultaneously anomalous during January 2026 mega-cap earnings), asset-class-specific catalysts, and a recurring 24/7 market-structure effect tied to weekends and U.S. holidays. Price tracking accuracy reveals a sharp maturity gradient: crypto coin perpetuals exhibit near-perfect price tracking (ρ≥0.999) and strong TradFi volume co-movement (ρ(0)∈[0.72,0.83]), while equity perpetuals show weaker integration and commodity perpetuals range from adequate (oil, gold) to unreliable (natural gas). We conclude that crypto DeFi perpetuals constitute credible synthetic economic claims on underlying assets, while equity and commodity perpetuals remain at an early developmental stage. Integration with traditional financial markets is well-established for crypto coin perpetuals; for equity and commodity perpetuals, the evidence is preliminary, given short observation windows, and further research with longer time series is needed before definitive conclusions can be drawn.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】去中心化金融（DeFi）的永续期货产品已从最初基于加密货币的金融工具扩展到基于代币化的股票和商品，但这些金融工具的经济学原理仍缺乏深入理解。我们研究了2025年7月至2026年2月期间，在三个DeFi永续期货平台（Hyperliquid、EdgeX、Lighter）上交易的17种资产——包括5种加密货币、8种代币化股票和4种代币化商品。通过应用滚动3天t检验方法（无需预先设定的事件日历）来识别异常交易量，我们发现了1797次具有统计显著性的交易量异常现象。DeFi永续期货的交易量主要受宏观经济因素和政策冲击的影响（例如，美国加密货币战略储备计划宣布时ADA的交易量显著增加；2026年1月大型股公司财报发布期间，有17种资产中的15种同时出现交易量异常）；此外，资产类别特定的催化剂以及与周末和美国节假日相关的市场结构效应也是影响交易量的重要因素。价格跟踪能力的分析显示：加密货币永续期货的价格跟踪精度非常高（ρ≥0.999），且与传统金融市场的交易量存在显著相关性（ρ(0)∈[0.72,0.83]）；而股票永续期货的价格跟踪能力较弱，商品永续期货的价格跟踪能力则参差不齐（石油和黄金的...。研究方法：时间序列。

papers.title: Do Green Bonds Deliver? Green Innovation, Financing Constraints, and High-Quality Development Among Chinese A-Share Listed Firms
papers.abstract: Every dollar directed toward green finance carries a promise, but does it deliver? This study tests whether corporate green bond issuance translates into measurable improvements in firm-level high-quality development, which is defined as the enhancement of firms’ sustainable growth capacity and resource allocation efficiency and is proxied by total factor productivity (TFP), a widely adopted indicator of development quality in the economics literature. Using panel data from Shanghai and Shenzhen A-share listed enterprises over 2014–2024, we employ a multi-period difference-in-differences framework, validated by parallel trend and placebo tests, to identify the causal effect of green bond issuance. Results confirm a significant positive impact, with green bond issuance raising firm TFP by 0.240 units, representing a substantial improvement in firms’ productivity performance relative to the sample average, robust across Olley–Pakes, Levinsohn–Petrin, and propensity score matched specifications. Mechanism analysis identifies three transmission channels: green technological innovation and green management practices operate as partial mediators, while financing constraints serve as a mediator. Heterogeneity tests reveal stronger effects among firms with higher agency costs, heavier pollution burdens, and those located in eastern China’s more marketized regions. By uncovering the productivity-enhancing mechanisms of green bond issuance, this study enriches the literature on sustainable finance and corporate high-quality development and provides new firm-level evidence on the economic consequences of green financial instruments. These findings provide micro-level evidence that green finance generates tangible productivity gains beyond signaling, offering actionable guidance for policymakers advancing sustainable corporate development under China’s dual carbon targets.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】每一笔用于绿色金融的资金都承载着期望，但它们真的能够实现这些期望吗？本研究旨在探讨企业发行绿色债券是否能够带来企业层面高质量发展的可衡量改善。所谓高质量发展，指的是企业可持续增长能力和资源配置效率的提升，这一指标在经济学文献中通常通过全要素生产率（TFP）来衡量。我们利用2014至2024年间上海和深圳A股上市公司的面板数据，采用多期差分分析法（并通过平行趋势检验和安慰剂检验进行验证），以确定绿色债券发行的因果效应。研究结果证实，绿色债券发行确实对企业的全要素生产率产生了显著的正向影响，使其提高了0.240个单位，相对于样本平均水平而言，企业的生产率表现有了显著提升。这一效应在Olley–Pakes模型、Levinsohn–Petrin模型以及基于倾向得分匹配的模型中均具有稳健性。机制分析表明，绿色技术创新和绿色管理实践起到了部分中介作用，而融资约束也起到了中介作用。异质性分析显示，代理成本较高、污染负担较重以及位于中国东部市场化程度较高的地区的企业，其绿色债券发行的效果更为显著。通过揭示绿色债券发行提升生产率的机制，本研究丰富了可持续金融与企业高质量发展相关的研究文献，并为企业...。研究方法：双重差分、倾向得分匹配、面板数据。

papers.title: Implementasi Pembangunan Ekonomi Berbasis Islam dalam Peberdayaan Masyarakat
papers.venue: Maslahah : Jurnal Manajemen dan Ekonomi Syariah
papers.abstract: The economic sanctions imposed on Iran since 2018 have not been lifted until 2024. Amidst this pressure, Iran has become a kind of open laboratory for the implementation of Islamic economics at the state level. The question is, to what extent is this system capable of empowering society when access to global finance is blocked? This study attempts to answer this by examining three pillars implemented by Iran between 2018 and 2024. First, the government issued a $2.5 billion Musharakah Sovereign Sukuk in 2023 to finance infrastructure projects without interest. Second, the Central Bank of Iran aggressively increased its gold reserves from 108 tons to 200 tons as a form of safeguard against the SWIFT blockade. Third, the distribution of zakat and waqf (waqf) began to be digitized through the Iran Electronic Zakat Fund, which by 2023 had distributed $340 million to nearly 280,000 MSMEs. This research utilizes a literature review of 42 documents, including Scopus articles from Q1–Q3, IMF and World Bank reports, and World Gold Council data. When measured against the framework of the maqasid sharia (Islamic principles), Iran appears to have successfully maintained its hifz al-din (obligatory welfare) aspect through a fully Islamic banking system. However, its hifz al-mal (obligatory welfare) aspect has faltered. As of March 2024, inflation was recorded at 45.8%, and the poverty rate reached 31.7%. The conclusion is that normative adherence to sharia principles does not automatically guarantee prosperity when geopolitical factors come into play. The synergy between sukuk, gold, and digital philanthropy does form an attractive Resistance Economy model. However, without global political stability, this model functions more as a shield than as a growth engine. These findings are important for other Muslim countries considering a similar path.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】自2018年起对伊朗实施的经济制裁直到2024年才被解除。在这种压力下，伊朗成为了国家层面推行伊斯兰经济体系的“开放实验室”。问题在于：当全球金融渠道被切断时，这一体系在多大程度上能够推动社会进步？本研究通过分析伊朗在2018至2024年间实施的三项举措来尝试回答这一问题。首先，政府于2023年发行了25亿美元的“Musharakah Sovereign Sukuk”债券，用于无息资助基础设施项目；其次，为应对SWIFT系统的封锁，伊朗中央银行积极增加黄金储备，从108吨增加到200吨；第三，通过“伊朗电子扎卡特基金”（Iran Electronic Zakat Fund）实现了扎卡特（zakat）和瓦克夫（waqf）的数字化发放，截至2023年，该基金已向近28万家中小微企业（MSMEs）发放了3.4亿美元。研究基于42份文献进行综述，包括Scopus数据库中2023年第一季度至第三季度的相关文章、国际货币基金组织（IMF）和世界银行的报告以及世界黄金理事会的数据。从伊斯兰教法原则（maqasid sharia）的角度来看，伊朗似乎通过完全基于伊斯兰教法的银行体系成功维护了“h...。
